correctness.rationale: For n=2k>=4, a constructive bijection identifies perfect matchings with independent sets of the column cycle. The equivariant simplicial map collapsing each opposite rim pair is a homotopy equivalence by an explicit contiguous section. After removing exactly two full alternating tile facets, the remaining subcomplex has a good cover by spoke stars with all intersections cones, hence is contractible. The pair exact sequence gives an integral basis of rank two, and direct ordered-cell permutations yield the two matrices. Their group relations and determinant-two eigensublattice index are verified algebraically. Finite direct matching enumeration through n=14 corroborates, but does not replace, these uniform proofs.

value.rationale: The most natural unresolved structural point after even-width rational rotation actions is integral splitting. The theorem settles this for every even width, identifies a nonzero order-two obstruction throughout the width congruent to two modulo four subfamily, gives explicit canonical bases and both dihedral generator actions, and provides a simple contractible-core explanation. This is a full meaningful infinite-family integral classification, not a trivial restatement or arbitrary finite table.
